/*selectMasterCmClProxyRecinpayStatementList*/
SELECT (SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CATEG_SYS_ID=SUBSTR(X.CATEG_SYS_ID, 1, 8)) AS CATEG_NAME1 , (SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CATEG_SYS_ID=SUBSTR(X.CATEG_SYS_ID, 1, 12)) AS CATEG_NAME2 , DEPTH3_NAME , BASIC_QTY , BASIC_AMT , GR_QTY , GR_AMT , CHUL_QTY , CHUL_AMT , JO_QTY , JO_AMT , LAST_QTY , LAST_AMT , BEFORE_GR_CLOSE_QTY , BEFORE_GR_CLOSE_AMT , AFTER_GR_CLOSE_QTY , AFTER_GR_CLOSE_AMT , BEFORE_CHU_CLOSE_QTY , BEFORE_CHUL_CLOSE_AMT , AFTER_CHUL_CLOSE_QTY , AFTER_CHUL_CLOSE_AMT , NOT_DELY_QTY , NOT_DELY_AMT , STOCK_QTY , STOCK_AMT FROM ( SELECT /*+ APPEND PARALLEL(A, 4) USE_HASH(B A) */ MAX(CATEG_SYS_ID) AS CATEG_SYS_ID , (SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM CMSCATEG WHERE CMS_CATEG_ID=B.PID) AS DEPTH3_NAME , SUM(A.BASIC_QTY) AS BASIC_QTY , SUM(A.BASIC_AMT) AS BASIC_AMT , SUM(A.GR_QTY) AS GR_QTY , SUM(A.GR_AMT) AS GR_AMT , SUM(A.CHUL_QTY) AS CHUL_QTY , SUM(A.CHUL_AMT) AS CHUL_AMT , SUM(A.JO_QTY) AS JO_QTY , SUM(A.JO_AMT) AS JO_AMT , SUM(A.LAST_QTY) AS LAST_QTY , SUM(A.LAST_AMT) AS LAST_AMT , SUM(A.BEFORE_GR_CLOSE_QTY) AS BEFORE_GR_CLOSE_QTY , SUM(A.BEFORE_GR_CLOSE_AMT) AS BEFORE_GR_CLOSE_AMT , SUM(A.AFTER_GR_CLOSE_QTY) AS AFTER_GR_CLOSE_QTY , SUM(A.AFTER_GR_CLOSE_AMT) AS AFTER_GR_CLOSE_AMT , SUM(A.BEFORE_CHU_CLOSE_QTY) AS BEFORE_CHU_CLOSE_QTY , SUM(A.BEFORE_CHUL_CLOSE_AMT) AS BEFORE_CHUL_CLOSE_AMT , SUM(A.AFTER_CHUL_CLOSE_QTY) AS AFTER_CHUL_CLOSE_QTY , SUM(A.AFTER_CHUL_CLOSE_AMT) AS AFTER_CHUL_CLOSE_AMT , SUM(A.NOT_DELY_QTY) AS NOT_DELY_QTY , 0 AS NOT_DELY_AMT , SUM(A.STOCK_QTY) AS STOCK_QTY , SUM(A.STOCK_AMT) AS STOCK_AMT FROM KEP_STOCK_MNG A /* 구매대행재고수불 */ , CMSCATEG B /* KeP표준카테고리(CMS) */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.YYYYMM = #{st_from_date} AND A.CMS_CATEG_ID = B.CMS_CATEG_ID GROUP BY B.PID ) X ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
